veranderings.rede: The buildings were introduced as 'hierdie geboue' two sentences earlier; switching to 'daardie' right after 'Daardie werk' blurs the reference.

veranderings.blok: Hoekom lyk twee skole nie altyd eenders nie?
veranderings.rede: 'Geboue kry dakke' is loose spoken usage; 'het' is the natural written verb and adds no words.
